primary_operating_point: maximum validation recall subject to FPR <= 0.10

development_boundaries.existing_locked_status: The frozen baseline and MOSAIC-v0 cohort was already evaluated once under evaluation_freeze_manifest.json. Any later MOSAIC-v1 evaluation on the same cohort must be described as a frozen benchmark test, not as newly untouched data.

features: semantic cluster retention and alternative support

recoverability_rule.margin_definition: mean length-normalized log score(candidate) - log score(canonical answer) over accepted natural rewrites assigned to the candidate cluster

behavioral_pathway.quality_gate: Generated rewrites must pass a label-blind semantic-equivalence audit. Failed rewrites use fixed wrappers that retain the original question verbatim. Unverified natural panels remain diagnostic artifacts only.

internal_pathway.stacking_requirement: Expert predictions used by a gate must be strictly cross-fitted. Internal base-probe features used for development OOF model selection require nested cross-fitting.
internal_pathway.internal_competitive_phenotype: No fixed canonical-NLL cutoff is used. A candidate is internal-competitive only after a development-selected intervention produces a positive candidate-vs-canonical margin change beyond no-op, random-direction, unrelated-donor and shuffled-candidate controls, and the direction is confirmed on validation.

mosaic_v1_candidates: learned gate with partial phenotype auxiliary supervision

mechanism_requirements.candidate_source: validated non-original NLI cluster; never gold

known_provisional_artifacts.natural_paraphrase_v1: Question semantic equivalence was not checked; retain as diagnostic only.
known_provisional_artifacts.mosaic_v1_public_v1: mosaic_v1_full duplicates the observable-phenotype gate and does not implement an auxiliary phenotype loss.
known_provisional_artifacts.internal_trajectory_v1: Validation features are development-trained, but development expert OOF stacking is not fully nested.
